title: Effect of changing one coordinate
statement: For every natural number $n$, coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and sign vector $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$, the normalized sum with coordinate $i$ set to $1$ minus the normalized sum with that coordinate set to $-1$ equals $2/\sqrt n$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
